content.test_md_blob:
# Reject invalid credentials at the login boundary

> Prove invalid credentials do not grant access and produce an understandable failure state instead of an authenticated session.

## Step 1

Open https://qaplayground.com/bank/login in a browser.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-13, ac-19

Enter username {{invalid_username}} and password {{invalid_password}} on the Bank Demo login page and submit Sign In, then assert an understandable failure state is shown and an authenticated banking experience is not available.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open https://qaplayground.com/bank/login in a browser.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: forbidden-presence
      operand: authenticated banking experience after invalid authentication
      operator: exists
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-13
    objective: Enter username {{invalid_username}} and password {{invalid_password}} on the Bank Demo login page and submit Sign In, then assert an understandable failure state is shown and an authenticated banking experience is not available.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-13
      - ac-19
scenario: Reject an invalid username or password
title: Reject invalid credentials at the login boundary
